title: OpenRTB 2.6 Banner
description: Represents the most general type of impression including simple static images, expandable ad units, or in-banner video.

format.description: Array of Format objects representing the banner sizes permitted.

btype.description: Blocked banner ad types. 1 = XHTML Text Ad, 2 = XHTML Banner Ad, 3 = JavaScript Ad, 4 = iframe.

battr.description: Blocked creative attributes. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Creative Attributes.

pos.description: Ad position on screen. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Placement Positions.

topframe.description: Indicates if the banner is in the top frame as opposed to an iframe.

expdir.description: Directions in which the banner may expand. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Expandable Directions.

api.description: List of supported API frameworks for this impression. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: API Frameworks.

id.description: Unique identifier for this banner object. Recommended when Banner objects are used with a Video object for companion ads.

vcm.description: Companion banner rendering mode relative to the associated video, where 0 = concurrent, 1 = end-card.

ext.description: Placeholder for exchange-specific extensions to OpenRTB.
